pr.title: Count a reviewer on another machine before reporting a pull request unreviewed
pr.head: 0ca258983629eba58d6a47f985659a62e2baa7d7

summary: The watch daemon tells a pull request’s fixer when its ready head has no reviewer it can see. A reviewer waiting on another machine was invisible between reviews, which made that notice misleading.

This change adds review targets to each encrypted session presence, the registration record shared through a repository’s relay. The receiving daemon counts live remote review targets before emitting UNREVIEWED. Targets stay within that repository, and dropped pull requests remain explicit exclusions.

cards.title: Review result
cards.html: One P2 remains: a repository reviewer’s adopted pull requests are not shared. After GitHub clears a review request, another machine without the adoption history can incorrectly report that no shared-relay reviewer exists.

cards.title: Validation
cards.html: The configured gate and focused watch, relay, agent, and packaging tests pass. A separate temporary two-machine reproduction confirms the adoption-history gap.

groups.title: Publish scoped review targets
groups.kicker: Review subscriptions travel with encrypted session registrations
intro: A presence is a session’s registration with an expiration time. The relay now reads the session’s subscriptions whenever it seals that presence, so registrations created by an older version gain review targets at renewal.

Each target names either this repository or one of its pull requests, with the reviewing model. Exclusions come before repository targets and individual pull requests within the 32-entry cap. Nothing in this payload names subscriptions in another repository.

files.note: Builds and validates scoped review entries and marks registrations pending when review subscriptions change.

checks.text: Traced the subscription-edit hook through registration refresh; explicit summaries remain intact, while changed review targets trigger republishing.

files.note: Seals current subscriptions into each presence and reads live remote review lists from a recent cache.

checks.text: Traced cache filtering: only the operator’s login, another machine, a live presence, and a repository polled within its lease contribute review targets.

files.note: Exercises two temporary machines, repository scoping, subscription updates, older registrations, older records, and the sealed size limit.

groups.title: Use remote coverage before notifying fixers
groups.kicker: Remote review targets suppress only the unreviewed notice
intro: The daemon keeps local ownership and routing unchanged. It consults each remote presence before telling a fixer that no reviewer covers the current head, matching explicit pull-request targets directly and applying exclusions per model.

For repository targets, coverage depends on the receiving machine’s adoption history. Adoption remembers a pull request after a review request disappears. That history can differ between machines, which leaves the open finding below.

files.note: Combines local review owners, live start comments, and remote review targets in the UNREVIEWED decision.

checks.text: A remote repository reviewer can retain a third-party pull request after its review request disappears, while a newly started fixer machine has no adoption history. The remote reviewer receives NEW HEAD, but this check emits UNREVIEWED saying no shared-relay reviewer exists. Carry the reviewer’s adopted coverage rather than inferring it only from the receiving machine’s cache.

files.note: Checks relay-aware notice wording, liveness, login and machine filtering, request coverage, and exclusions.

groups.title: Explain the notice’s visibility limits
groups.kicker: Commands and fixer instructions state which machines were checked
intro: The CLI reference documents the presence payload and the conditions under which a notice includes other machines sharing this repository’s relay. The fixer skill asks the agent to repeat that scope and avoids claiming that no reviewer exists anywhere.

files.note: Documents remote targets, exclusions, renewal compatibility, rejection, and the scoped UNREVIEWED notice.
Routes an UNREVIEWED notice as scoped information for the user rather than work for the fixer.
